assumptions: Illustrative non-nested fixed vector priority, one pending flag per timer, finite 400 byte stream. Timer0 COMPB nominal period 4096 cycles, Timer0 OVF 16384 assuming Arduino core /64, WDT nominal 16ms; T1 and Advance periods and all non-UART costs synthetic sensitivity parameters, NOT linked path measurements. ADC polled inside PWM on audited baseline, not a separate vector. Does not emulate Timer1 safe nesting, actual compare reschedule, STEP edges, watchdog oscillator, UDR shift pipeline at sub-frame granularity, TX empty interrupt, stack or parser; no software ring in this model. RX FIFO two entries and full at next start conservative. TX offered work queue is synthetic and can grow without limit; not physical TX ring. Loss phases are deterministic sampled offsets, not probabilities. Timer costs include synthetic entry/return, add 1 cycle dispatch deferral. No safety claims.
